item.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
item.description: Can useful context survive after the prompt disappears? A careful look at learning new behavior while preserving the old. Takeaway: Retest older examples after every update, even when the original weights stay frozen. Caveat: Fifty compatible factual edits are not indefinite lifelong learning. Replay also changes the optimization budget.

item.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
item.description: Compress a document’s attention cache for questions that have not been asked yet. Takeaway: Preserve both what a memory returns and how strongly it competes for attention. Caveat: 16× describes logical key-value compression, not measured physical memory savings or faster inference. Preparation is expensive.

item.title: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory
item.description: A compact memory bank helps a world model predict latent states and plan from images. Takeaway: Compact latent conditioning can help planning, but a learned prior is not a growing episodic memory. Caveat: Small simulation study; no inference-time write rule. The paper does not clearly define its error bars.
